system.description: You can become a creature of pure darkness — a humanoid formed of liquid shadow. Expend three Blood Traits and spend three full turns in concentration to complete the transformation. As a shadow, you are immune to physical attacks, though you still take damage from fire, magic and sunlight. You cannot interact with the mortal world, having no substance, but can attack people by enveloping them — a challenge of your Mental Traits versus the victim's Physical Traits. If you succeed, the victim is affected as with Nocturne. You can glide along any surface or through any crack, see through total darkness, and use most mental Disciplines (though not Dominate, since you have no eyes). Your blood is transformed into the same shadow, immune even to the effects of Thaumaturgy. Unfortunately, sunlight and fire are extremely painful — you suffer a one-Trait penalty in Courage Tests when facing them.
